anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
Trading metrics such as totalPL, activeTrades, closedTrades, winRate, and ROI are all at zero, suggesting a potential issue with the trading system or inactivity.
AI system has not performed any recent learning cycles or generated opportunities, indicating a possible malfunction or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially reactivate trading strategies to ensure they are functioning as expected.
Evaluate AI system configurations to ensure it is set up to perform learning cycles and generate trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting the platform's reliability.

recommendations.action: Audit the trading system to ensure strategies are active and functioning correctly.
recommendations.rationale: Trading inactivity could result in missed opportunities and financial losses for users.

recommendations.action: Check AI system configurations and logs to diagnose why it is not performing learning cycles or generating opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could hinder the platform's ability to adapt and optimize trading strategies.
